name: subagent-spawn-cap
description: A total-spawns-per-session budget for subagents: a PreToolUse guard on the Agent tool that counts every spawn in a session (nested spawns from inside subagents included), asks for approval at SPAWN_CAP_ASK (default 20) and every SPAWN_CAP_ASK_STEP spawns after it (default 10), and denies at SPAWN_CAP_DENY (default 60): prompts at 20, 30, 40, 50, hard stop at 60. Closes the gap left when Claude Code 2.1.224 removed its native per-session spawn cap; the native concurrency and depth caps bound the rate, not the total. Append-only per-session ledger, so parallel spawns in one turn are all counted. SPAWN_CAP_ALLOW=true lets spawns through while set, still counted.
